# CrimeSceneCleanerJobs

> The premier job board for biohazard remediation, trauma scene cleanup, and environmental hazard specialists.

## What it is

A specialized job board connecting crime scene cleanup companies with certified technicians. No generalist job board noise — only biohazard, trauma, and hazmat roles.

## Who posts here

- Biohazard remediation companies
- Trauma scene cleanup services
- Environmental hazard contractors
- HAZMAT response firms

## Who finds work here

- Biohazard cleanup technicians
- OSHA-certified trauma scene specialists
- Environmental remediation workers
- Crime scene restoration contractors

## Key facts

- Listings include pay range, location, job type, and direct contact
- Employers can post a job for a flat $99 fee
- Job seekers browse and apply for free
- AI-assisted job parsing available for employers

## Platform

Built on React + Firebase. Real-time job listings.
